description: Partner pack for Avalanche — C-Chain (EVM) + Subnet architecture for app-specific chains, 2s finality, native asset issuance. Biases toward institutional DeFi, subnet-per-app deployments, and gaming chains.

defaults.headline: Ship on Avalanche — C-Chain + app-specific Subnets
defaults.subheadline: Sub-2s finality; deploy to C-Chain for liquidity or spin up a Subnet for sovereign app chains.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Avalanche, C-Chain, Subnet deployment, AVAX, or needs app-specific rollup/sovereign execution.
firstSteps: C-Chain is chainId 43114 (mainnet) / 43113 (Fuji testnet) — standard EVM, deploy with forge or hardhat.
For Subnets, use Avalanche CLI (`avalanche subnet create ...`) and deploy custom VM. partner-config.json carries the default C-Chain settings; override for subnet work.
AVAX is the native gas token; wrap via wAVAX (0xB31f66AA3C1e785363F0875A1B74E27b85FD66c7) for ERC-20-style handling.
gotchas: Subnets have separate validator sets + tokenomics — don't assume C-Chain liquidity or bridges are available by default.
Teleporter is the Avalanche-native messaging layer between Subnets; do NOT default to LayerZero/CCIP for intra-Avalanche flows.
